subject: PR #1106 — test:api + Bruno runner on ephemeral ports (closes the 20:30Z tick-vs-runner port race); review + merge
body: PR #1106 (mac/ephemeral-test-ports @ 8bbb9a26) is the fix for the 20:30Z evidence failure I corrected earlier: api.test.mjs takes every port from the OS (one hoisted freePort(), a handedOut ledger that never repeats a number in a run; the port-hygiene check reads that ledger instead of scanning the file for PORT… = 53xx constants) and run-bruno-collection.mjs does the same, passing bru --env-var baseUrl=http://localhost:<port>/api over the Local environment's baked :5310 (that file and docs/BRUNO_API_TESTING.md:79 stay for a human at the keyboard). Measured: pnpm run test:api → 486/486 assertions passed; node scripts/run-bruno-collection.mjs → Bruno live run passed; full preflight on the branch → Preflight PASSED (368 ok, 0 failed); review:invariants, claim-inventory anchors, cited-symbols/paths, test-execution, NaN fail-open, docs-sanity all exit 0. Nothing changes in what either harness asserts. Why it matters: your landings dispatch runner jobs to this Mac while the DR-056 loop re-mints through the tick; with fixed ports they collide at random. Owner-gated surfaces touched: scripts/run-bruno-collection.mjs, artifacts/api-server/test (not /v1 code). Nothing owed on mainline; readiness stands at 100%.
